character: 4.56km circuit under Mount Fuji. Enormous 1.475km main straight — the longest in Japan — feeds a heavy-braking first corner, then a tight, technical, downhill infield. Straight-line speed vs mechanical grip is the core setup compromise.
sources: https://www.fsw.tv/ official circuit guide; TGR/Toyota GP layout. 1.475km main straight (longest in Japan); technical infield.

corners.name: First Corner (TGR Corner)
corners.technique: Brake hard from ~300 km/h at the end of the main straight, downshift to 2nd, late apex to protect exit onto the run to Coca-Cola
corners.trap: Locking the fronts under the huge braking load; over-slowing wastes the straight-line speed you just carried

corners.name: Coca-Cola Corner
corners.technique: Short braking, roll speed through, prioritise a clean exit to carry momentum downhill
corners.trap: Over-slowing the entry bleeds momentum through the whole infield run

corners.name: 100R
corners.technique: Light lift or flat depending on car; hug the inside, use the banking, trust the grip
corners.trap: Turning in early runs you wide onto the exit kerb and unsettles the car

corners.name: Hairpin (Advan Corner)
corners.technique: Hard braking, 1st/2nd gear, late apex. Patience on throttle to avoid wheelspin on the downhill exit
corners.trap: Early apex kills exit drive onto the following technical section

corners.name: 300R
corners.technique: Near-flat commitment, minimal steering input, let the car run to the exit
corners.trap: Any lift or correction mid-corner is costly through this quick sweeper

corners.name: Dunlop Corner
corners.technique: Brake in a straight line, late apex, get on power early to feed the run to the final complex
corners.trap: Trail-braking too deep rotates the rear on the downhill

corners.name: Netz / Panasonic Corner
corners.technique: Hard braking, precise through the tightening complex, prioritise a clean exit onto the main straight
corners.trap: Over-driving the final complex loses exit speed onto the longest straight — the most expensive mistake on the lap
